inspected_scope: Seed, prior UOVA design schemas/contracts, all eight task contracts, SWU-UOVA-004 receipt, current scene modules, three current tests, and two discovery-only Inventory entries.

findings.claim: The approved scene schema stores a full semantic sourceRelationBinding but makes portalConstituent and pathHop reference-first while task prose requires predicate copies.

Current runtime is hybrid by accident: SourceGraph owns and indexes complete immutable relation bindings; KnowledgeScene copies reduced relation records but has no explicit facet identity, digest, or resolver contract.
The design schema declares oew.knowledge-scene.v1 while implemented sceneQuery emits v1.1; downstream repair must reconcile schema/version ownership before mutation.
Aggregate graph/View Pack revision checks exist, but no per-relation facet or snapshot digest proves copied predicate, cue, and evidence fields have not drifted.
Current SourceGraph is the only demonstrated semantic owner; geometry and inspector/index contracts are identity-based consumers.

A_denormalized.reason: fast reads and export but duplicated semantic truth and exhaustive equality burden

B_reference_first.reason: clean ownership but resolver and detached-output gaps

C_immutable_facet.reason: strong revision and serialization behavior but highest migration cost and explicit facet law required

compatibility.SWU-UOVA-001: valid unchanged if SourceRelationBinding and source_relation_id remain canonical
compatibility.SWU-UOVA-002: valid unchanged if View Pack never owns relation semantics
compatibility.SWU-UOVA-003: partition evidence remains valid; a facet boundary needs a versioned adapter or validated legacy snapshot

surviving_change_requests: Define one canonical relation-reference law with typed stale and missing failure.
Reconcile KnowledgeScene v1 versus implemented v1.1 before downstream changes.
Make portal and Path semantic fields resolved or validated snapshots, never independent owners.
Add relation/facet digest and negative drift tests.
Keep Full Index source-derived and static output self-contained through a validated snapshot envelope.
Preserve completed SWU-UOVA-003 evidence through an explicit compatibility witness.
rejected_claims: Adding exact_predicate only to portalConstituent resolves the architecture.
Reference-only records alone satisfy detached output.
Completed SWU-UOVA-001 through 003 prove downstream consumers.
The current Body War 237/231 fixture proves planned 276/301/39/577 acceptance.

standalone export retention and migration policy
